cohort: Two hundred and eighty women, including 40 pregnant nulliparous women for the reliability study, were observed during pregnancy (12 and 36 weeks gestation) and 6 months postpartum.
finding: Midurethral area and mean echogenicity were significantly lower 6 months after delivery compared with 12 and 36 weeks of gestation, indicating structural changes in the midurethra during pregnancy.
